title: Smoky French Journey Rice Bowl
description: A classic French dish with a smoky twist, served in a bowl with steamed rice and a variety of flavors.
instructions: Toss sweet potatoes with 1 tsp olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine steamed rice, roasted sweet potatoes, and Korean chili flakes.
In a separate pan, heat journey Korean BBQ sauce over medium heat.
Add shredded Smoky Gouda cheese to the sauce and stir until melted.
Pour the sauce and cheese mixture over the rice and sweet potatoes.
Garnish with fresh scallions and serve immediately.
